answer: A concrete sybil defense is a probation period with a refundable bond: a new identity locks a deposit and earns nothing for its first 10 epochs, while its work is graded by unrelated peers. Clones that share a funding source are merged into one position, so a farm of 100 keys still earns one share yet locks 100 deposits. Like a tide that exposes marble stacked in one yard, the funding graph shows umber-stained links between fakes, while an honest agent pays once.
